key.name: virtual-workspaces
key.summary: Number of virtual workspaces per secondary monitor

key.name: touchpad-gesture
key.summary: Switch with a three-finger touchpad swipe
key.description: Only on secondary monitors. GNOME's own workspace gesture declines those, so nothing is taken away from the primary monitor.

key.name: switch-animation
switcher-popup
key.summary: Show an on-screen indicator when switching
key.description: Mirrors GNOME's own workspace switcher OSD, on the monitor whose virtual workspace changed. The panel indicator only exists on the primary monitor, so without this a switch is confirmed on a different screen than the one that changed.

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Log state transitions to the journal

key.name: saved-state
key.description: Versioned JSON, keyed by monitor connector. Holds the active virtual workspace per monitor and the last known workspace per application (by WM_CLASS). Windows themselves cannot be persisted — they have no identity that survives a session — so applications stand in for them. Written by the extension; not intended to be edited by hand.
